root_cause.text: In the ksmbd subsystem, `parse_durable_handle_context()` fails to release the reference count of a `ksmbd_file` (obtained via `ksmbd_lookup_fd_cguid()`) when a durable v2 open request has a matching CreateGuid but a mismatched ClientGUID, resulting in a file descriptor leak.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that "when an entry exists in the global file table with the same CreateGuid but a different ClientGUID, the code simply falls through to the new-open path without dropping the reference obtained from ksmbd_lookup_fd_cguid()". This is supported by the patch diff in `fs/smb/server/smb2pdu.c`, which adds `ksmbd_put_durable_fd(dh_info->fp)` and clears `dh_info->fp` to release the reference in the mismatch path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a reference count leak by releasing the durable file pointer reference and nullifying it during durable handle context parsing.
intent_record.what: Added calls to ksmbd_put_durable_fd(dh_info->fp) and set dh_info->fp to NULL within the parse_durable_handle_context function.
intent_record.how: Releases the reference to the durable file pointer and clears the pointer, preventing a reference count leak when the connection state is not successfully reestablished.
